instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Clasp your hands together behind your back.
3. Straighten your arms and lift them slightly away from your body.
4. Pull your shoulders back until you feel a stretch in the front of your upper arms.
5. Hold, then release.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your chest open and shoulders pulled back.
2. Do not arch your lower back to reach further.
3. Adjust your grip width so you feel the stretch in the upper arm, not the wrists.
4. Breathe out slowly to help the muscle relax.

instructions:
1. Lie on your back and lift your hips off the floor.
2. Support your hips with your hands, keeping your elbows on the floor.
3. Extend your right leg straight forward while bending your left knee toward your torso.
4. Switch legs, extending the left leg and bending the right knee.
5. Keep a steady, controlled pedaling motion.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Support your lower back firmly with your hands.
2. Engage your core to control the leg motion.
3. Keep the movement smooth and controlled.
4. Slow down if your lower back starts to arch.

instructions:
1. Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
2. Raise your legs to about 45 degrees off the floor, keeping them straight.
3. Bring your right knee toward your chest while twisting to touch your left elbow to it.
4. Switch sides, bringing your left knee in and your right elbow toward it.
5. Continue alternating in a controlled, bicycle-like motion.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Twist using your core, not your neck or shoulders.
2. Keep your lower back pressed to the floor.
3. Do not pull on your neck with your hands.
4. Exhale as you rotate.

instructions:
1. Lie on your back with your legs bent and lifted off the floor.
2. Keep both arms flat on the floor beside you.
3. Bring your right knee toward your chest while straightening your left leg without touching the floor.
4. Switch sides, bringing the left knee in and straightening the right leg.
5. Continue alternating in a controlled, bicycle-like motion.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Use your abs to control the leg movement.
2. Keep your lower back pressed to the floor.
3. Keep the motion slow and controlled.
4. Do not let the extended leg touch the floor.

instructions:
1. Lie on your back with your hands behind your head and legs lifted off the floor.
2. Bring your right knee toward your chest while extending your left leg out.
3. Twist your torso to touch your left elbow to your right knee.
4. Switch sides, bringing the left knee in and your right elbow toward it.
5. Continue alternating in a controlled, bicycle-like motion.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Twist using your core, not your neck or shoulders.
2. Keep your lower back pressed to the floor.
3. Keep your elbows wide and do not pull on your head.
4. Exhale as you rotate.
